_comment: Merge into .claude/settings.json. The cheap check only: format the file that was just touched, print nothing, always exit 0. Hook stdout is injected into the agent's context, so a chatty hook on every edit costs tokens on every edit. The tool input arrives on stdin as JSON, not in an env var. Add a case arm per language you actually have a formatter for; anything without one is covered at commit instead.

hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.rs) rustfmt "$f" 2>/dev/null;; esac; exit 0
